summary: Fix systemd 257 (Debian 13) credential handling: no --no-ask-password, no unit-loaded backup key, root-only SMB mount credentials files, and no receipt echo in storage registration responses.

guide.reason: Operator steps are unchanged; the fixes make the documented SMB, S3 and service-start workflows work on Debian 13.

api.reason: POST /api/v1/storage no longer echoes the write-only credential_receipt and credential_request_id, as its schema already states; no request, schema or Core command changes.

roadmap.reason: Bug fixes; no milestone or acceptance gate changes.

state.record: Root-only credentials files in the Core state directory (storage-credentials/<receipt>, backup-smb-credentials/<reference>) plus the receipt JSON beside them; credential_receipts in the Core inventory is the adoption path.
state.reason: SMB mount credentials remain Core-local files in the existing receipt directories (storage-credentials, backup-smb-credentials), addressed by the same receipts that the pool master's journal records; a fresh Controller adopts receipts through the existing credential_receipts inventory. Only the file format changes from sealed to root-only plaintext.

verification.method: Focused Go tests for the vmhost, agent and controller packages with a stubbed systemd-creds; real Debian 13 CIFS mount, reboot remount and fresh-host unit start were not run.
